title: Emily Roebling completes the Brooklyn Bridge
summary: When chief engineer Washington Roebling became bedridden with caisson disease, his wife Emily carried the bridge project for more than ten years until it was completed.
why: One of the great engineering works of the 19th century.

unsung.contribution: Managed technical work on the Brooklyn Bridge for over a decade after her husband fell ill.
unsung.recognition: The New York Times published a belated obituary in 2018 for people overlooked at their deaths; an honorary doctorate came in 2024.
